User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account details and profile information

uid.description: Unique identifier of the user matching Firebase Auth UID

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when account was created

lastLogin.description: ISO timestamp of last sign in

DiaryEntry.title: Mood Diary Entry
DiaryEntry.description: Daily journal thoughts, mood state, and personal reflections

id.description: Unique identifier for the diary entry

userId.description: UID of the user who authored this entry

mood.description: Mood rating: happy, anxiety, sad, or cry

ChatMessage.title: AI Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Conversational messages between user and Wellspring AI Companion

userId.description: UID of the user participating in chat

role.description: Role of the sender: user or model

AssessmentRecord.title: Mental Wellness Assessment Record
AssessmentRecord.description: User response score and outcome from the 10-question mental assessment

userId.description: UID of the user who took assessment

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles keyed by their Firebase Auth UID

/diaries/{diaryId}.description: Stores all mood journal entries created by users

/chat_messages/{messageId}.description: Stores chat messages for AI companion conversations
